stories.headline: Colombia arrests 13 in an alleged Wayuu-pressuring network shipping cocaine from La Guajira to the Caribbean and Europe
stories.summary: Raids reported around October 15 hit Riohacha, Manaure, Maicao and Uribia in La Guajira and Los Palmitos in Sucre, taking down a group accused of serving the Autodefensas…

stories.headline: Colombian Navy chases down a Pacific go-fast boat carrying 1.46 tonnes of cocaine bound for Costa Rica
stories.summary: The Navy, with US Southern Command support, stopped the boat in the Pacific and took its three Colombian crew members and cargo to the Buenaventura coast guard station.
